jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

### **Purpose of the Job**



The Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management is a senior member of the CRO’s leadership team and serves as the CRO and Deputy CRO’s primary partner on enterprise risk governance, leading the second\-line ERM function and the continued development and operation of a forward\-looking risk management program aligned with regulatory expectations and commensurate with EQ Bank’s size, scope and complexity.  

  

The VP, ERM will provide the vision and roadmap to further embed ERM across the organization, working closely with business leaders to strengthen risk management capabilities while providing independent oversight and effective challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role will oversee the Bank’s enterprise\-wide view of risk, including its Board\-approved Risk Appetite Framework, management and reporting of key risks, and reporting to the Board and Enterprise Risk Management Committee (ERMC), while supporting the CRO and Deputy CRO in interactions with OSFI and other regulatory stakeholders.  

  

The VP, ERM will also lead the risk management aspects of integration of PC Financial with EQ Bank and build a high\-performing ERM team that is nimble and innovative, enabling EQ Bank to achieve its strategic objectives while operating within its risk appetite.



### **Risk Governance**

* Lead the risk governance program. This covers owning and maintaining EQ Bank’s ERM framework, policy inventory, the annual review cycle, committee charters, escalation protocols, and coordinating policy submissions for ERMC.
* Act as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact with OSFI for the Risk function. Coordinate supervisory meetings, information requests, reviews, and follow\-up questions across the bank.
* Monitor OSFI guidance and regulatory developments affecting risk, capital, and liquidity. Assess their impact, lead the Bank's readiness plans, and promote a strong risk culture through clear accountability and training.
### **Risk Reporting**

* Own the CRO's quarterly reporting to the ERMC and the Board. This covers the enterprise risk dashboard, top and emerging risks, and the risk profile against appetite.
* Run ERMC as its secretariat and content lead. Set agendas, bring together reporting on credit, financial, operational, compliance and strategic risks, and track decisions and actions.
* Turn complex, multi\-risk information into short, decision\-focused insight for both committees. Bring forward material issues, top\-risk assessments, and thematic deep dives so leaders can act early.
* Prepare the CRO and Deputy CRO for committee discussions, and manage the Board risk agenda, follow\-up actions, and the annual risk governance calendar.
* Keep improving the reporting suite through better data, more automation, and a consistent risk taxonomy across the enterprise.
### **Risk Identification \& Assessment \& Risk Appetite Monitoring**

* Lead the annual enterprise\-wide risk assessment. Identify, assess, and rank material and emerging risks with the business lines and second\-line partners, and use the results to set the top\-risk inventory and ICAAP risk coverage.
* Run the annual refresh of the Risk Appetite Framework and Statement. Recalibrate metrics, limits, and early warning indicators to reflect the strategic plan, the financial forecast, stress testing results, and changes in the business, including the PC Financial portfolios.
* Steer the refresh through governance from management review to ERMC endorsement and Board approval. Cascade the approved appetite into business\-line limits and policies.
* Monitor risk appetite metrics against Board and management limits throughout the year. Report position and trends to ERMC and the Board.
* Run the escalation and remediation process for limit breaches and amber trends, including root\-cause analysis and tracking of corrective actions.
### **Risk \- Integration Management Office (IMO) and Convergence for PC Financial**

* Lead the risk workstream of the PC Financial integration. Coordinate second\-line oversight of integration milestones, synergy delivery, and the associated risks.
* Drive the convergence of PC Bank's risk frameworks, policies, limits, reporting, and controls onto EQ Bank's enterprise standards. Make sure combined\-entity reporting is accurate and complete.
* Lead the OSFI reporting related to IMO \& Convergence activities for the entire bank.
### **Let's Talk About You!**

* A university degree in Finance, Business, Economics or a quantitative field. A graduate degree (MBA or Master's) or a professional designation such as CFA, FRM, PRM or CPA is an asset.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in a financial institution in a leadership capacity and at least 10 years’ experience in the ERM function leading quantitative teams
* Broad and deep experience in various risk functions, including credit, operational, market, stress testing and IRRBB
* Deep knowledge of OSFI expectations, including Corporate Governance, E\-21, B\-20, CAR, LAR and ICAAP. Direct experience managing supervisory relationships
* Has built a high\-performing team: recruits, trains, and mentors talent to drive employee retention and engagement. Provid

jobs.title: AI Risk Director - Global AI Risk Management
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 279160
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

Leads and oversees a team within the Data \& AI Risk (DAIR), GRM group ensuring the Enterprise Artificial Intelligence (AI) Risk strategies, implementation program and mandated activities are executed / delivered in compliance with the governing regulations, internal policies and procedures, and in support of innovation and business strategy.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**


* Lead and drive a customer focused culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge to execute the AI Risk Management Program.
* Support the VP, Data \& AI Risk in shaping and executing the Enterprise AI Risk strategies.
* Design and implement the AI Risk Program including management of AI Risk Management policies, procedures, metrics and processes.
* Establish and lead the independent second\-line AI risk management oversight and challenge function to support identification, assessment, monitoring and escalations of AI risk in collaboration with other risk partners.
* Lead the roll\-out and ongoing execution of the AI Risk Management Program among business lines/corporate offices and geographies, which includes but is not limited to the following:
	+ Develop, refine, and enhance the assigned AI risk framework components, policies, procedures, processes, tools, and metrics with the objective to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the AI risk.
	+ Ensure AI Risk Management policy enforcement and compliance through appropriate governance and oversight mechanisms.
	+ Establish and lead the execution of the 2nd line risk oversight, effective challenge, risk measurement and reporting (NIRAs, RCSA, internal management reports, senior management, and/or Board reports), including identification and escalation of material and emerging risks.
	+ Advise and collaborate with first line business lines, corporate functions, key stakeholders with regards to the AI risk management principles, standards, controls, and best practices, while maintaining effective second\-line independence and challenge.
	+ Partner with AI Governance and Model Risk Management functions, Technology, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance and other key partners with identification, communication and reporting of relevant AI risk priorities, successes, issues, dependencies and regulatory expectations.
	+ Guide and influence various stakeholders across the organization to achieve the goals defined in the DAIR and AI Risk Management strategies and programs, including the responsible adoption of emerging AI technologies.
	+ Support resolution of risk governance and management issues by driving coordination, alignment and timely escalation where required.
	+ Lead AI risk awareness events and training sessions on AI risk management framework, policy, 2nd line of defense processes, metrics and reporting.
* Provide oversight on the prioritization and remediation plans for AI risk\-related issues: measure, report and monitor key AI risk indicators, identify compliance gaps and risk issues, guide risk impact\-focused gap and issue prioritization and creation of action plans to remediate gaps and issues, monitor plan execution, and escalate material or overdue issues in accordance with the Bank's risk governance framework.
* Monitor relevant global regulatory developments and assess their potential implications for the Bank's AI risk management framework, controls and risk posture.
* Ensure that own and team’s day\-to\-day activities are conducted in a manner consistent with the Bank’s risk culture and the relevant risk appetite statement and limits. Communicate the Bank’s risk culture and risk appetite statement throughout his/her team.
* Develop or contribute to ad\-hoc reporting to the Board, risk committees, and senior leadership, including the collection of metrics and reports
* Act as a thought leader in AI risk governance, representing the organization in various industry forums and panels
* Create an environment in which the team pursues effective and efficient operations within respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct, and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day\-to\-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.
* Build a high\-performance environment and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? \- We'd love to work with you if you have:**


* Minimum 7 years of relevant progressive experience in compliance, risk management, legal or analytics, model or AI governance.
* Deep understanding of AI technologies, ML/AI risk management best practices, relevant global laws, regulations, and ethical and risk management standards.
* Strong grasp of global and regional AI regulations.
* Curious and proactive and agile learner interested in new technology, ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic risk management best practices, trends and developments in data and AI governance.
* Experience in leading the development of policies, risk assessments and conducting training programs to establish effective AI risk oversight practice with defined success measures.
* Very strong organizational, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated experience and skills in collaboration, teamwork, and problem\-solving to achieve strategic objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to spark innovation and act as a trusted advisor to help teams use AI responsibly.
* D

jobs.title: Director of Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
At PwC Canada, we're transforming the way we work—and the way our people and clients experience technology. Our Products \& Technology team builds the digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled platforms that power the firm and shape the future of professional services. We're a community of solvers combining technology, data, and human ingenuity to deliver sustained outcomes that matter. We're looking for a Director of Solution Architecture to lead our established team of Senior Solution Architects—a technically deep, business\-savvy leader who can set direction, grow and develop talent, and partner with senior leaders across the firm to turn ambitious ideas into reality. Reporting to the Architecture and Development Leader, you will lead PwC Canada's Solution Architecture practice within Products \& Technology. You will take ownership of our established team of Senior Solution Architects, elevate their performance, and grow the team's capabilities as our technology ambitions expand. The team designs AI\-enabled products, enterprise applications, and platforms used across the firm's lines of service, ensuring our solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, aligned with enterprise architecture standards—and deliver real business value. This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role. While your focus is on design and technical direction rather than execution, you'll be expected to understand the technology from the inside. You'll go deep into architecture diagrams, integration designs, data flows, platform configurations, and the realities of how solutions are implemented, engaging with technical trade\-offs at a practitioner level. Your credibility with the team and with stakeholders will come from genuine technical depth and a willingness to go hands\-on with architecture and implementation details when the situation calls for it, not from high\-level concepts alone. Equally, this role operates at the intersection of business and technology. You'll be a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and organizational leaders, translating complex challenges into clear technology solutions, influencing strategic direction, and communicating in terms that resonate with executives. You'll also help shape how PwC Canada adopts emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI.**The Opportunity**

As a Director of Solution Architecture, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:


* Provide architecture oversight for digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled solutions from ideation through production
* Lead solution design decisions, balancing reusable platform components with business\-specific needs
* Guide the architecture of enterprise applications—including SaaS platforms, ERP, CRM, HR, finance, and collaboration systems—ensuring effective integration, extensibility, and alignment with our broader technology ecosystem
* Go hands\-on with architecture and technical implementation details when needed—working through complex integration patterns, data flows, platform configurations, or design problems alongside the team
* Advise on the adoption of emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI
* Manage, coach, and mentor an established team of talented Senior Solution Architects, elevating performance and fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning
* Grow the team's capabilities over time—identifying skill gaps, developing talent from within, and recruiting new members as the practice expands
* Evolve team structure and define new roles as the practice grows and technology priorities shift
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Data, Security, and Risk teams to ensure solutions align with firm standards
* Participate in architecture review boards and technology governance forums, advising on governance requirements, risk assessments, and policy exceptions
Contribute to PwC's broader architecture community—locally and across the global PwC network  
* 

  

**What You’ll Bring**

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here’s what we look for:


* Experience in technology roles, including significant time in solution or enterprise architecture, with extensive experience designing and delivering solutions within large, complex organizations
* Proven experience leading, developing, and growing a team of Senior Solution Architects—setting technical direction, elevating performance, and fostering a high\-performance culture, including in an Agile/DevOps environment
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
* Azure Cloud Platform certifications (Solutions Architect or Developer) preferred; TOGAF certification
* Strong technical depth as an architect—able to engage with the technology from the inside, work through implementation\-level details, and go hands\-on with architecture and design when the situation requires it
* Enterprise application architecture, including SaaS and COTS platforms (ERP, CRM, HCM, finance, collaboration, workflow), integration patterns (APIs, iPaaS, event\-driven), and configuration vs. customization trade\-offs
* Cloud\-native architectures on Azure (AWS/GCP nice to have), including containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code
* Generative AI and agentic AI solution design, including LLM integration, RAG patterns, and responsible AI practices
* Enterprise software architecture and design patterns, including service\-oriented, event\-driven, and microservices architectures; data architecture and persistence strategies (RDBMS, NoSQL); and Big Data, analytics, and AI/ML architecture
* Security\-by\-design, privacy, and compliance considerations, plus vendor and product evaluation, including RFP processes, proof\-of\-concepts, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership

jobs.title: Finance Director, Canada
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

We are seeking an exceptional, strategic finance leader to serve as Finance Director for our Canada team, overseeing a business generating $250\+ million in revenue across Real Estate Management Services, Markets, and Leasing. This is a high\-impact, business\-partnering role for a finance professional who thrives on influencing strategy rather than simply reporting on it — someone who can surface the right data at the right moment, challenge assumptions constructively, and serve as a trusted sounding board to senior business leaders across the region. You'll drive financial planning and reporting while shaping the corporate strategy and vision for Canada, working hand\-in\-hand with leadership to translate financial insight into decisive action. The ideal candidate understands commercial real estate and professional services, exceptional partnering skills, and high level corporate finance.
  
  

This role is based out of JLL's Corporate office in Toronto and requires being in\-office 4 days/week (flexibility to work remote one day/week). The Finance Director leads a small team and plays a key role on JLL Canada's Executive Leadership team. You will work closely with leaders across all business lines and report into a Global Finance team.
  
  

**What your day\-to\-day will look like:**  

Strategic Financial Leadership
  
Serve as the primary strategic finance partner and advisor to the Country CEO, country business line leaders, country functional leaders, and regional/global finance leadership.
  
Lead the preparation, management, consolidation, and delivery of the annual financial plan, reforecasts, and long\-range planning efforts.
  
Drive proactive, data\-informed decision\-making across all stakeholder groups.
  
Translate global business line strategy into local Canada priorities, providing the financial insights and analysis that connect country\-level execution to business line direction and identify opportunities to support revenue growth and margin improvement.
  
Oversee the integrity of all financial processes within your scope of responsibility.
  
Bridge discussions between business leadership and technical finance teams to inform, guide and influence business decisions
  
Performance Management \& Reporting
  
Lead the preparation and delivery of comprehensive monthly financial reporting and analysis for country, business, and finance leadership.
  
Produce and analyze monthly/quarterly financial variance reports with actionable insights.
  
Develop pipeline reporting and key performance metrics for business and service lines.
  
Facilitate pipeline reviews as a forum to inform decision\-making and develop forecasts.
  
Oversee all fiscal reporting activities, ensuring timeliness, accuracy, and strategic relevance.
  
Own the month\-end close cadence in partnership with the Controllership team, ensuring timely and accurate financial close.
  
Identify and diagnose the root cause(s) of margin variance and proactively bring recommendations to remedy
  
Client \& Commercial Finance
  
Lead finance input on major client relationships and contracts, including pricing, fee structuring \& negotiations, and contract issue resolution.
  
Support client\-specific commercial finance matters such as capital\-funded project reimbursements and rebate pool administration, in partnership with account and operations teams.
  
Leadership \& Team Development
  
Lead and develop a high\-performing finance team within the realm of FP\&A and business partnering.
  
Create and execute succession planning and professional development programs.
  
Partner in compensation planning and design to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
  
Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  
Act as an ambassador for the broader Finance function across the organization
  
  

**Required qualiﬁcations:**  

10\+ years progressive financial leadership experience.
  
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce.
  
Proven track record of leading financial strategy and operations in complex businesses.
  
Outstanding business partnership skills with experience advising and shaping strategy alongside business unit executives.
  
Experience leading high\-performing teams through periods of growth and change.
  
Superior analytical capabilities and financial modelling expertise
  
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial concepts.
  
Strategic mindset with demonstrated ability to drive business results.
  
Demonstrated experience owning a planning/budgeting cycle forecast process for a business unit or country.
  
  

**Preferred qualiﬁcations:**  

CPA/CFA preferred.
  
Bilingual English/French considered a strong asset.
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL

jobs.title: Director, Credit Adjudication, Non-Bank Financial & Asset Dealer Finance
jobs.description:
Application Deadline:


12/05/2026
Address:


100 King Street West
Job Family Group:


Audit, Risk \& Compliance
**Shape high\-impact credit decisions in a specialized lending environment.**

As Director, Credit Adjudication, Non\-Bank Financial \& Asset Dealer Finance, you will serve as an independent credit authority responsible for assessing complex transactions, providing objective risk recommendations, and ensuring sound credit decisions aligned to the bank's risk appetite and governance standards. Whether your experience comes from credit adjudication, risk management, or a business line underwriting role with delegated lending authority, you will have the opportunity to apply your credit expertise to influence enterprise\-wide decisions, partner with senior stakeholders, and help strengthen portfolio quality across a dynamic and growing business. This role offers meaningful visibility, strategic influence, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact on both business performance and risk outcomes.


Provides independent, objective review and adjudication of credit applications and transactions for an assigned portfolio within credit limits or makes credit recommendations and escalates as required. Ensures the credit quality of the assigned portfolios are maintained within the Bank’s risk tolerance, policies \& procedures, and meet financing guidelines. Supports credit adjudication operations and initiatives. Provides training and support to teams and channels where the applications and transactions originate.


* Acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders for making business decisions and implementing strategic initiatives.
* Develops an expert understanding of business/group challenges.
* Networks with industry contacts to gather competitive insights and best practices.
* Recommends measures to improve organizational effectiveness.
* May consult to or serve on various committees and task forces.
* Provides credit coaching, training and support to direct team and other stakeholders as required.
* Works with stakeholders to ensure effectiveness of risk management controls, analysis and monitoring on a transactional and portfolio basis.
* Influences and negotiates to achieve business objectives.
* Identifies emerging issues and trends to inform decision\-making.
* Recommends business priorities, advises on resource requirements and develops roadmap for strategic execution.
* Manages resources and leads the execution of strategic initiatives to deliver on business and financial goals.
* Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues.
* Acts as the prime contact for internal/external stakeholder relationships, which may include regulators.
* Ensures alignment between stakeholders.
* Develops and manages comprehensive information management systems; designs and/or leads initiatives to improve processes, analysis and reporting.
* Integrates information from multiple sources to enable more efficient processes, enhanced analysis and/or streamlined reporting.
* Defines business requirements for analytics \& reporting to ensure data insights inform business decision making.
* Employs systems (e.g. customized exception reports, tracking reports etc.) to manage information.
* Breaks down strategic problems, and analyses data and information to provide insights and recommendations.
* Leads change management programs of varying scope and type, including readiness assessments, planning, stakeholder management, execution, evaluation and sustainment of initiatives.
* Leads the development of the communication strategy focusing on positively influencing or changing behaviour.
* Collaborates across BMO to develop communications strategies and ensure consistency of messaging, in order to positively influence or change behaviour.
* Leads the execution of operational programs; assesses and adapts as needed to ensure quality of execution.
* Supports credit due diligence activities for bank acquisitions or integration.
* Reviews and communicates decisions on credit transactions with rationale that can be understood and explained to customers.
* Identifies and advises on terms, conditions and collateral requirements for the transaction decision as well as opportunities for cross\-selling and/or alternative solutions to meet client’s needs.
* Keeps abreast of economic and market developments within the portfolio to inform decision making and credit risk policies.
* Provides approval for exceptions according to established policy and standards.
* Monitors the credit portfolio through transaction review \& approval to ensure compliance with the Bank’s lending policies and procedures.
* Provides credit risk coaching and advice to sales \& service employees to increase awareness of risk, policy, and knowledge of structuring transactions.
* Builds effective relationships with internal/external stakeholders.
* Gathers and formats data into regular and ad\-hoc reports, and dashboards.
* Monitors and tracks performance and addresses any issues.
* Executes work to deliver timely, accurate, and efficient service.
* Operates at a group/enterprise\-wide level and serves as a senior specialist resource across BMO.
* Influences how teams/groups work together.
* Applies expertise and thinks creatively to address unique or ambiguous situations and to find solutions to multiple, interdependent, complex problems.
* Communicates abstract concepts in simple terms.
* Fosters strong internal and external networks and works with and across multiple teams to achieve business objectives.
* Anticipates trends and responds by implementing appropriate changes.
* Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
**Qualifications:**
* Typically 9\+ years of relevant experience and post\-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Credit Qualifications and associated credit knowledge and skills according to the established qualification st

new_jobs.title: Director of Solution Architecture
new_jobs.description:
At PwC Canada, we're transforming the way we work—and the way our people and clients experience technology. Our Products \& Technology team builds the digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled platforms that power the firm and shape the future of professional services. We're a community of solvers combining technology, data, and human ingenuity to deliver sustained outcomes that matter. We're looking for a Director of Solution Architecture to lead our established team of Senior Solution Architects—a technically deep, business\-savvy leader who can set direction, grow and develop talent, and partner with senior leaders across the firm to turn ambitious ideas into reality. Reporting to the Architecture and Development Leader, you will lead PwC Canada's Solution Architecture practice within Products \& Technology. You will take ownership of our established team of Senior Solution Architects, elevate their performance, and grow the team's capabilities as our technology ambitions expand. The team designs AI\-enabled products, enterprise applications, and platforms used across the firm's lines of service, ensuring our solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, aligned with enterprise architecture standards—and deliver real business value. This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role. While your focus is on design and technical direction rather than execution, you'll be expected to understand the technology from the inside. You'll go deep into architecture diagrams, integration designs, data flows, platform configurations, and the realities of how solutions are implemented, engaging with technical trade\-offs at a practitioner level. Your credibility with the team and with stakeholders will come from genuine technical depth and a willingness to go hands\-on with architecture and implementation details when the situation calls for it, not from high\-level concepts alone. Equally, this role operates at the intersection of business and technology. You'll be a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and organizational leaders, translating complex challenges into clear technology solutions, influencing strategic direction, and communicating in terms that resonate with executives. You'll also help shape how PwC Canada adopts emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI.**The Opportunity**

As a Director of Solution Architecture, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:


* Provide architecture oversight for digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled solutions from ideation through production
* Lead solution design decisions, balancing reusable platform components with business\-specific needs
* Guide the architecture of enterprise applications—including SaaS platforms, ERP, CRM, HR, finance, and collaboration systems—ensuring effective integration, extensibility, and alignment with our broader technology ecosystem
* Go hands\-on with architecture and technical implementation details when needed—working through complex integration patterns, data flows, platform configurations, or design problems alongside the team
* Advise on the adoption of emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI
* Manage, coach, and mentor an established team of talented Senior Solution Architects, elevating performance and fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning
* Grow the team's capabilities over time—identifying skill gaps, developing talent from within, and recruiting new members as the practice expands
* Evolve team structure and define new roles as the practice grows and technology priorities shift
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Data, Security, and Risk teams to ensure solutions align with firm standards
* Participate in architecture review boards and technology governance forums, advising on governance requirements, risk assessments, and policy exceptions
Contribute to PwC's broader architecture community—locally and across the global PwC network  
* 

  

**What You’ll Bring**

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here’s what we look for:


* Experience in technology roles, including significant time in solution or enterprise architecture, with extensive experience designing and delivering solutions within large, complex organizations
* Proven experience leading, developing, and growing a team of Senior Solution Architects—setting technical direction, elevating performance, and fostering a high\-performance culture, including in an Agile/DevOps environment
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
* Azure Cloud Platform certifications (Solutions Architect or Developer) preferred; TOGAF certification
* Strong technical depth as an architect—able to engage with the technology from the inside, work through implementation\-level details, and go hands\-on with architecture and design when the situation requires it
* Enterprise application architecture, including SaaS and COTS platforms (ERP, CRM, HCM, finance, collaboration, workflow), integration patterns (APIs, iPaaS, event\-driven), and configuration vs. customization trade\-offs
* Cloud\-native architectures on Azure (AWS/GCP nice to have), including containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code
* Generative AI and agentic AI solution design, including LLM integration, RAG patterns, and responsible AI practices
* Enterprise software architecture and design patterns, including service\-oriented, event\-driven, and microservices architectures; data architecture and persistence strategies (RDBMS, NoSQL); and Big Data, analytics, and AI/ML architecture
* Security\-by\-design, privacy, and compliance considerations, plus vendor and product evaluation, including RFP processes, proof\-of\-concepts, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership

new_jobs.title: Finance Director, Canada
new_jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

We are seeking an exceptional, strategic finance leader to serve as Finance Director for our Canada team, overseeing a business generating $250\+ million in revenue across Real Estate Management Services, Markets, and Leasing. This is a high\-impact, business\-partnering role for a finance professional who thrives on influencing strategy rather than simply reporting on it — someone who can surface the right data at the right moment, challenge assumptions constructively, and serve as a trusted sounding board to senior business leaders across the region. You'll drive financial planning and reporting while shaping the corporate strategy and vision for Canada, working hand\-in\-hand with leadership to translate financial insight into decisive action. The ideal candidate understands commercial real estate and professional services, exceptional partnering skills, and high level corporate finance.
  
  

This role is based out of JLL's Corporate office in Toronto and requires being in\-office 4 days/week (flexibility to work remote one day/week). The Finance Director leads a small team and plays a key role on JLL Canada's Executive Leadership team. You will work closely with leaders across all business lines and report into a Global Finance team.
  
  

**What your day\-to\-day will look like:**  

Strategic Financial Leadership
  
Serve as the primary strategic finance partner and advisor to the Country CEO, country business line leaders, country functional leaders, and regional/global finance leadership.
  
Lead the preparation, management, consolidation, and delivery of the annual financial plan, reforecasts, and long\-range planning efforts.
  
Drive proactive, data\-informed decision\-making across all stakeholder groups.
  
Translate global business line strategy into local Canada priorities, providing the financial insights and analysis that connect country\-level execution to business line direction and identify opportunities to support revenue growth and margin improvement.
  
Oversee the integrity of all financial processes within your scope of responsibility.
  
Bridge discussions between business leadership and technical finance teams to inform, guide and influence business decisions
  
Performance Management \& Reporting
  
Lead the preparation and delivery of comprehensive monthly financial reporting and analysis for country, business, and finance leadership.
  
Produce and analyze monthly/quarterly financial variance reports with actionable insights.
  
Develop pipeline reporting and key performance metrics for business and service lines.
  
Facilitate pipeline reviews as a forum to inform decision\-making and develop forecasts.
  
Oversee all fiscal reporting activities, ensuring timeliness, accuracy, and strategic relevance.
  
Own the month\-end close cadence in partnership with the Controllership team, ensuring timely and accurate financial close.
  
Identify and diagnose the root cause(s) of margin variance and proactively bring recommendations to remedy
  
Client \& Commercial Finance
  
Lead finance input on major client relationships and contracts, including pricing, fee structuring \& negotiations, and contract issue resolution.
  
Support client\-specific commercial finance matters such as capital\-funded project reimbursements and rebate pool administration, in partnership with account and operations teams.
  
Leadership \& Team Development
  
Lead and develop a high\-performing finance team within the realm of FP\&A and business partnering.
  
Create and execute succession planning and professional development programs.
  
Partner in compensation planning and design to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
  
Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  
Act as an ambassador for the broader Finance function across the organization
  
  

**Required qualiﬁcations:**  

10\+ years progressive financial leadership experience.
  
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce.
  
Proven track record of leading financial strategy and operations in complex businesses.
  
Outstanding business partnership skills with experience advising and shaping strategy alongside business unit executives.
  
Experience leading high\-performing teams through periods of growth and change.
  
Superior analytical capabilities and financial modelling expertise
  
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial concepts.
  
Strategic mindset with demonstrated ability to drive business results.
  
Demonstrated experience owning a planning/budgeting cycle forecast process for a business unit or country.
  
  

**Preferred qualiﬁcations:**  

CPA/CFA preferred.
  
Bilingual English/French considered a strong asset.
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL
